title: HF2644 (2025-2026 Regular): Definition of crime of violence modified for firearms crimes.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-03-24; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/HF/2644/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced (as filed). The bill strikes "and chapter 152 (drugs, controlled substances);" from the list. The long list of offence cites between the two quoted pieces is omitted; the quote is split in two at the section's start and end.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.712, subd. 5): "Crime of violence" means: felony convictions of the following offenses: sections 609.185 (murder in the first degree); 609.855, subdivision 5 (shooting at a public transit vehicle or facility); and an attempt to commit any of these offenses.
